text: Welcome to my office. I understand you are suffering from chronic diarrhea and lower abdominal discomfort. To begin our evaluation, how long have these symptoms been occurring, and have you noticed any blood or mucus in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 31-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months. She mentions lower abdominal discomfort and cramping, which is relieved by diarrhea. The patient notes the bowel movements are urgent, occasionally accompanied by mucus discharge, and often followed by a feeling of incomplete evacuation. She went camping several months ago and recalls another member of the camping party falling ill recently.

speaker: Doctor

Given the mucus and urgency, have you experienced any fever, significant weight loss, or recent travel to areas outside of your usual environment?

Have you noticed any fevers, night sweats, or unintended weight loss? Also, do you have any history of similar symptoms or inflammatory bowel disease in your family?
